patch_list: Raises pet intimacy to the highest level.
Removes daily caps on store refreshes, blind boxes, feeding, petting and the Book of Answers. Opens the Item Recycling Center every day and shortens pet exploration to three minutes.
Buys every store item without running out of cat coins.
Unlocks premium goals, journeys, breathing exercises, focus timers, sounds and themes.
